title: Chapter 387: Moon Godkiller
content:
Chapter 387: Moon Godkiller

Therefore, Lu Daosheng will always have a backup plan.

How dare you provoke him if you are a mere land of gods?

snort.

Lu Daosheng snorted lightly, then broke through the space, stepped out, and disappeared from the spot.

The surrounding space suddenly turned into a phantom, constantly rushing behind him.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng's speed reached the extreme, and everything around him was automatically avoided, for fear of touching him.

However, just as Lu Daosheng was speeding at such a speed, a subtle change suddenly occurred in front of him.

"Um?"

Lu Daosheng asked suspiciously and his speed suddenly slowed down.

The next moment, the space tunnel ahead was suddenly broken open by a terrifying brute force.

Rumble!

Countless fragments of space passed by Lu Daosheng's eyes, like beautiful meteors.

But at this moment, Lu Daosheng was not in the mood to appreciate it, but instead looked ahead with a low expression.

If an ordinary person does not prepare in advance, he will definitely be severely damaged by the surrounding space debris or even die.

Who will it be?

As Lu Daosheng looked closely, a phantom gradually appeared in the distance.

"No matter who you are, wherever you come from, go back."

The phantom made a low voice.

The sound was extremely terrifying, shaking the fragments of the space around the body into powder.

If it were an ordinary person, he would have been frightened by this momentum and fled in a hurry, but Lu Daosheng was not an ordinary person.

In response to this, Lu Daosheng just snorted lightly, his face was not afraid, and his hands were forever power, and then he shot towards the phantom in the distance.

Seeing that Lu Daosheng dared to resist, the phantom whispered, "An ant who doesn't know the height of the sky and the earth."

Buzz —

Starlight flowed, and all the terrifying offensives surged out of the phantom's body.

In the face of the phantom's offensive, Lu Daosheng's tiny attack seemed so ridiculous.

But such a ridiculous attack made the phantom's face change.

The originally proud face was replaced by a deep and solemn feeling.

I saw that Lu Daosheng's attack was like destroying all the stars, and then continued to go towards the phantom, as if he had entered a state of no one.

"Yu!"

The phantom shouted coldly, and the figure quickly retreated behind him.

boom!

With a loud bang, the phantom breath suddenly became listless.

With just one blow, he was injured.

He didn't know that this was the result of Lu Daosheng's deliberate resolute action.

"Who are you?"

The phantom gradually condensed and turned into a man with a gloomy expression and a purple-patterned robe. He looked like a human race, but his aura was a bit dirty.

Hearing the man's question, Lu Daosheng walked slowly towards him with a sneer.

"Why, now you know who I am?"

The man looked ugly, but he didn't say anything more.

Lu Daosheng snorted coldly, "Who gives you the courage to block my way?"

A terrifying pressure suddenly crushed the man. It was not until this moment that the man deeply realized how powerful the opponent in front of him was.

However, deep in his fearful eyes, there was a hint of joy.

All of this was seen by Lu Daosheng.

Seeing that the man was still silent, Lu Daosheng stopped talking and reached out to grab the man, and the man was immediately grabbed by Lu Daosheng.

"If I don't say it, I have a way to know."

As Lu Daosheng pressed his palm against the man's heavenly spirit cover, the next moment, the man burst into a creepy scream.

Search the soul!

Feeling the tearing from the soul, the man was in pain and screamed.

But he didn't have the power to resist.

In front of Lu Daosheng, any of his methods was so ridiculous.

It lasted for a long time.

Lu Daosheng slowly let go.

The man had lost consciousness at this moment, his eyes turned pale and foamed at the mouth.

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at the man quietly. He did not kill him anymore. Through soul searching, he already knew why this man was here and blocked him.

This man is the land of the gods, the so-called lackeys of God.

He was given some strength by God to do things for God.

Many weak little worlds were trampled by this guy, and then the spoils were presented to God by him.

Therefore, in the land of the gods, this guy has a great status and is highly valued by God.

Lu Daosheng should have been very disdainful of such a guy and directly killed him, but in his memory, Lu Daosheng saw another side.

Moon clan.

This is the race of this man.

However, according to Lu Daosheng's understanding, this so-called Moon Clan is just a branch of the human race. As the bloodline continues to disperse, it is only changed to its name.

In the final analysis, this guy's ancestors are definitely a lineage of the human race.

This is also the reason why this guy in front of him is so similar to the human race.

And this man is the leader of the Moon Clan and the strongest person of the Moon Clan.

When he was just born, he had an amazing vision in the Moon Clan, and was known as the savior who could change the entire Moon Clan and lead the Moon Clan to glory.

In the world where the Moon tribe is located, they are exploited and oppressed by God all year round, and they have to hand over a large amount of resources and tribe members every once in a while.

In this regard, the entire Moon clan naturally hated the gods extremely, and wished to peel off the gods, and their souls were burned forever.

However, the strength of the Moon Clan is a joke in the eyes of the Land of Gods.

The Moon Clan is not a strong man who has resisted, but without exception, he has been cruelly suppressed.

This situation continued until the appearance of this man.

With his peerless talent, he defeated all the geniuses all the way and grew to the strongest man of the Moon Clan. He was trained by the entire Moon Clan. Then, he was invincible in that world and for a moment, he was glorious.

His growth can be described as a legend.

And the moon clan was undoubtedly led to a new height by him.

His name is Yue Killing God, and he was born for the death of God for the rest of his life.

He once said, "God? So what about God? I wonder if I can survive three moves under my hands?"

"As long as God dares to come to my moon tribe, he will definitely make it come and go."

Finally, it was time to pay tribute again.

The messenger of God came to the Moon Clan. This time, under the leadership of the Moon Clan, the Moon Clan rose up to resist.

The messenger of God was killed.

After this battle, the Moon Clan's fighting spirit surged, and his fear of God also dropped sharply.

Seeing the Yue clan at this time, Yue Shi God knew that the opportunity to fight back was coming.

He personally led hundreds of top-level powerhouses in the Moon Clan and the other small clans to break through the barriers outside the boundary and aimed directly at the land of the gods!

Along the way, they were unstoppable and no enemy blocked their steps.

Yue Shi God also got his wish and finally broke into the land of the gods.

He finally saw God, the sharp sword hanging above his head since he was a child, the existence that awakened him from his nightmare every time.

Everyone knows how Yue Shi Shen hated God, you can tell by looking at the name.

But they didn't know that Yue Shi God was afraid of God in his bones, but the more this happened, the more Yue Shi God wanted to fight against God.

Because he wants to eliminate the fear in his heart.

The most important thing is that he wants to eliminate the fear in the hearts of his tribesmen.
